record: MC04-S7 Part B step 7, JL strip pass 4 (--renetted-uuids): replay inputs (Revision 11 addendum item 6)
command: bash scripts/kicad/run.sh python3 scripts/pcbgen/strip_drc_conflicts.py boards/osc-jack-left/osc-jack-left.kicad_pcb <drc_input> --moved $(cat <moved>) --record <record> --board-id osc-jack-left --max-share 0.25 --baseline-length-mm 19937.528 --renetted-uuids <renetted_uuids>, on the JL board after pass 3

renetted_uuids.derivation: copper (segment, arc, via) uuids whose net differs between the committed JL board and the synced board

drc_input.what: kicad-cli pcb drc JSON of JL after strip pass 3, the input of pass 4

moved.note: the pass 3 moved list; it selects no conflict pair at the pass 4 DRC input, so every removed item cleared a renetted pair
